screenshots.description: The shot scripts that show what this change does, for the before/after screenshots on the PR. Empty when nothing visible changed.

script.description: A tests/screenshots script name without .gd, e.g. shot_builder

caption.description: One sentence: what to look at in these shots

clips.description: The clips that show what this change does in motion, for the before/after clips on the PR (at most 4). Empty when no spell, combo or reaction looks different.

id.description: A clip id from the recorder (tests/clips/), e.g. combo_shatter

caption.description: One sentence: what to look at in this clip

owner_questions.description: Questions only the owner can answer (see Questions for the owner). May be empty.

title.description: A short question, for example: Allow sessions to run the Godot binary?

key.description: A short, stable kebab-case id for the decision, e.g. build-sh-four-bot-step. Use the same key whenever the same decision comes up again.

question.description: What is needed and why, in plain words

meanwhile.description: What the bot does until the owner answers

owner_change.description: true if the answer needs a change in an owner-only path

change.description: For owner_change: the exact change (a diff or the new lines)

screenshots.description: Up to three shot scripts whose shots show exactly what the owner decides on (taken on this branch and shown in the question). Leave it out when nothing visible is involved.

script.description: A tests/screenshots script name without .gd, e.g. shot_builder

caption.description: One sentence: what to look at in these shots
